page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores with a clock speed of 3.1 GHz and a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.8 GB of memory per core, and operates on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows solid multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 38,378.07 and a PassMark CPU score of 34,691.95. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2,133.36 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec. In database and key-value operations, the server achieves 34.78 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks and a PassMark database operations score of 14,249.04.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed, this server is well-suited for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from single-threaded performance, such as software compilation and ray tracing. It is also capable of handling medium-sized language model inference, processing 56.94 tokens per second for prompts on a 7B model. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for workloads that prioritize raw CPU and memory capacity over local disk I/O or hardware acceleration.
